title: The Forge of Fire
description: An anger transformation arc. The traveler's rage is not an enemy — it is raw material. In the forge, anger is hammered into a sword of clarity and a shield of boundaries.

acts.title: The Wildfire
acts.description: Fire consumes the landscape. The traveler is the fire and cannot stop burning. Everything they touch turns to ash.

acts.title: The Anvil
acts.description: A forge appears in the ruins. An ancient smith teaches: fire without containment destroys. Fire within a forge creates.

acts.title: The Tempered Blade
acts.description: The traveler forges their anger into a blade that cuts clean — honest words, firm boundaries, protective not destructive.
